data.name: GraFi Easter
data.detailed_description:
GraFi Easter is a colorful 2D physics puzzle game that combines gravity manipulation, challenging traps, moving treadmills, mysterious portals, and cheerful Easter-themed artwork. Change the direction of gravity, guide a small blue coin through tricky environments, and discover clever solutions in this festive collection of logic puzzles and brain teasers.

Step into a vibrant world of Easter-inspired physics puzzles where gravity is the key to every challenge. Instead of controlling the coin directly, manipulate gravitational forces to influence its movement. Experiment with different gravity directions, observe how the coin reacts, and use physics to overcome obstacles. Every level challenges your logical thinking, concentration, spatial reasoning, and precision.

Your objective is simple but surprisingly challenging: move the blue coin onto the blue rock and keep it there long enough to complete the level. Navigate dangerous traps, deal with moving treadmills, and overcome increasingly tricky puzzle layouts. Carefully plan each gravity change, anticipate the coin's movement, and discover the correct solution through experimentation and precise timing.

With 50 levels of gravity-based puzzle challenges, GraFi Easter offers an entertaining combination of classic physics puzzles, obstacle avoidance, and precision-based gameplay. Moving surfaces, portals, and challenging obstacles add variety to traditional gravity puzzles, encouraging creative thinking and careful planning.

Immerse yourself in a cheerful Easter and springtime atmosphere filled with colorful Easter egg artwork, festive decorations, and charming seasonal details. The minimalist 2D visuals combine bright colors with clean puzzle environments, creating a delightful holiday twist on the classic GraFi gameplay.

Whether you enjoy casual puzzle games, Easter games, challenging physics puzzles, or clever brain teasers, GraFi Easter offers an accessible yet rewarding single-player experience. Experiment with gravity, overcome tricky obstacles, and enjoy the satisfaction of completing each level while surrounded by colorful Easter aesthetics.

With its distinctive colorful 2D minimalist art, engaging background music, and straightforward gameplay mechanics, GraFi Easter delivers a festive puzzle experience where simple controls meet challenging physics. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, casual gamers, and anyone looking for an Easter-themed logic game that rewards careful observation, patience, and precise decisions.

Key Features

  • 50 challenging puzzle levels – Solve Easter-themed gravity puzzles that test your logic, concentration, timing, and precision.

  • Gravity manipulation gameplay – Change the direction of gravity to control the movement of a small blue coin.

  • Easter-themed physics puzzles – Enjoy creative gravity challenges surrounded by colorful holiday artwork and cheerful spring-inspired aesthetics.

  • Moving treadmills and conveyor belts – Navigate moving surfaces that influence the coin's movement and introduce additional physics challenges.

  • Portals and obstacles – Encounter portals and tricky environmental hazards while discovering effective solutions.

  • Blue coin challenges – Guide the coin onto the blue rock and keep it in position long enough to complete each level.

  • Dangerous traps – Avoid hazards and carefully plan your movements to overcome challenging puzzle layouts.

  • Logic puzzles and brain teasers – Exercise your problem-solving skills, spatial reasoning, patience, and attention to detail.

  • Precision and timing challenges – Determine when to change gravity and how to position the coin accurately.

  • Colorful Easter artwork – Enjoy vibrant 2D visuals featuring Easter eggs, festive decorations, and charming springtime colors.

  • Minimalist abstract graphics – Explore clean, colorful puzzle environments that keep the focus on gravity-based gameplay.

  • Engaging background music – Enjoy an atmospheric soundtrack that accompanies your Easter puzzle adventure.

  • Simple but challenging mechanics – Easy-to-understand objectives combined with physics puzzles that reward experimentation and creative thinking.

  • 100 Steam Achievements – Complete challenges and unlock achievements throughout your festive journey.

  • Steam Cloud support – Keep your game progress synchronized across supported devices.

  • Single-player puzzle experience – Solve gravity challenges at your own pace and enjoy a colorful Easter atmosphere.

Change gravity, overcome the traps, master the physics, and celebrate Easter with every puzzle you solve in GraFi Easter!
